impact_assessment.why: Reforge run-1 review found pre-bcrypt accounts cannot log in (check_hashes rejects non-bcrypt), quarantine files can overwrite within one second, and README calls the hard weekly limit soft
impact_assessment.benefits: Legacy users regain access and are upgraded to bcrypt; no quarantined state is lost; docs match code
impact_assessment.risks: contract: authenticate may write the user store on login; dependency: none; concurrency: whole-file users rewrite could drop a concurrent registration, narrowed by reloading before the write; state: stored hashes change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests per milestone, reload-before-write updating only that key, rehash failure never blocks login, project check before each commit, no push
